text: 你把独木舟转向岸边时，查理抓住了你的手臂。“教授，我的族人避开这座山谷。这里受到了诅咒。别去追赶住在里面的恶魔。”
向导以前也对你说过迷信之言，但查理的话中有种急切，让你感到不安。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 18
text: When you turn the canoe toward shore, Charlie grabs your arm. “Professor. My people avoid this valley. It is under a curse. Do not chase the devils who inhabit it.”
It is not the first time you have heard such superstition from a guide. But there is an urgency to Charlie’s words that unsettles you.
